correctness.rationale: A first-meeting tail swap of two continuous independent killed diffusions with starting points x<y gives two-time determinant inequalities for each exit channel. Dividing the positive boundary densities gives monotonic time-log ratios, hence x↦D(t,x) nonincreasing for all t>0. The regular Dirichlet Sturm–Liouville flux series yields c_{1,e}>0 and K2>0; φ2 has one simple node x*, and its sign plus spatial monotonicity ensure the unique late zero. At x* the entire φ2 term vanishes, giving D(t,x*)=K3 φ3(x*)/φ1(x*) e^{-(λ3−λ1)t}+o(·); division by ∂xD~K2 φ2′(x*)/φ1(x*) e^{-(λ2−λ1)t} proves the reported shift. This remains a little-oh estimate if the cubic coefficient vanishes. Domain is scalar uniformly elliptic C4 coefficients on a compact absorbing interval; no generalization to jumps or higher dimensions.
